items.name: Bulk Sheet Tool
items.desc: Builds, edits, validates and fixes Amazon Ads bulk sheets for Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, with the PLTFRM campaign naming convention built in. Covers new launches, bid changes, negatives from search term reports, renames, portfolio moves and "Finished with errors" uploads.
items.author: Matan L.

items.name: Brand Leakage Detector
items.desc: Reads keywords targeted in your B campaigns to build a brand dictionary, then scans every NB campaign search term for matches or close variants that are leaking spend or sales.
items.author: Hunter G.

items.name: SQP Reports
items.desc: Pulls Search Query Performance reports from Seller Central Brand Analytics for one or many weeks, months or quarters, then files them into the brand's SQP folder. Runs in Chrome through Claude in Chrome on a logged-in Seller Central session.
items.author: Matan L.

items.name: Placement Analysis
items.desc: Turns a Sponsored Products or Sponsored Brands placement report into bid multiplier decisions: Top of Search vs Rest of Search vs Product Pages efficiency, wasted spend to cut, and raise or cut calls by campaign, with a PLTFRM chart.
items.author: Matan L.

items.name: AMC SQL
items.desc: Writes and debugs Amazon Marketing Cloud SQL, including NTB, path to conversion, reach and frequency, blended CAC and Prime Video Insights queries, and reconciles AMC output against the DSP and Sponsored Ads consoles.
items.author: Matan L.

items.name: Amazon Spend Correlation
items.desc: This skill measures how closely an Amazon brand's ad spend tracks its total sales, organic sales, and SQP search share (impressions, clicks, purchases). It cuts the data account-wide, by product line, and by branded vs non-branded, with tentpole events excluded. The output is findings, callouts, and slides that inform budget decisions, like what happens if spend is cut or restored.
items.author: Matan L.
